name: tr_vince
caption:
IF VINCE HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐦 Rookidee: bravely challenges any opponent, no matter how powerful. Rookie of the Year in 1999, 18.3 a night
✈️ Pidgeot: races through the sky at Mach 2. Air Canada, 25.7 a night in year two
🤼 Hawlucha: strikes a pose, then ends it with a flashy finishing move. 2000 Slam Dunk champion: the 360 windmill, the elbow in the rim
🔥 Typhlosion: so hot that anything that touches it goes up in flames. 27.6 a night in 2000-01, still our single-season record
⚡ Zapdos: appears when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down. 50 points and 9 threes in a 2001 playoff game vs Philly
🐉 Rayquaza: lives so far above the clouds it can't be seen from the ground. No. 15, the first jersey we ever retired

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Vince Carter had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF VINCE CARTER HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Rookidee. It bravely challenges any opponent, no matter how powerful. Vince's first year with us: Rookie of the Year, eighteen point three a night.
beats.dlg: CHALLENGES ANY OPPONENT.|1999: ROOKIE OF THE YEAR!

beats.vo: Pidgeot. It races through the skies at Mach two. That's why they called him Air Canada. Year two: twenty-five point seven a night.
beats.dlg: IT RACES THROUGH THE SKY.|THEY CALLED HIM AIR CANADA

beats.vo: Hawlucha. It always strikes a pose, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move. Two thousand: the three-sixty windmill, the elbow in the rim. Dunk contest champion.
beats.dlg: A FLASHY FINISHING MOVE.|2000 DUNK CONTEST CHAMP!

beats.vo: Typhlosion. When its rage peaks, anything that touches it goes up in flames. Year three: twenty-seven point six a night. Still our record.
beats.dlg: ANYTHING IT TOUCHES BURNS.|27.6 PPG: STILL OUR RECORD

beats.vo: Zapdos. It appears when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down. Playoffs, twenty oh one, against Philly: fifty points, nine threes.
beats.dlg: LIGHTNING SHOWERS DOWN.|50 PTS, 9 THREES VS PHILLY

beats.vo: And the ace. Rayquaza. It lives so far above the clouds no one can see it. Twenty twenty-four: number fifteen, the first jersey we ever retired.
beats.dlg: LIVES ABOVE THE CLOUDS.|OUR FIRST RETIRED JERSEY

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Carter won the 1999 NBA Rookie of the Year Award averaging 18.3 points; nickname Air Canada; ascended to stardom in his second season (1999-00); won the 2000 Slam Dunk Contest with a 360 windmill and an elbow-in-the-rim dunk; in 2000-01, his third season, career-high 27.6 PPG, the Raptors' highest points per game in a season; 50 points in Game 3 vs the Philadelphia 76ers in the 2001 playoffs (May 11, 2001); on November 2, 2024 the Raptors retired his No. 15, the first Raptors player to have his jersey retired
Pidgeot races through the skies at Mach-2 (Mach 2) speed (PokeAPI species flavor text)
